note: 115 trait words, many of them near-synonyms, so each description has to earn its own angle: Calm is a pulse that does not move, Coolheaded is processing that does not degrade, Relaxed is a high threshold. Matched to existing rows like Altruistic, which show the trait through behavior and then turn.

entries.title: Aggressive
entries.description: Arrives at conflict early and does not wait to confirm it was necessary. Occasionally this is exactly what the moment required.

entries.title: Ambitious
entries.description: Wants the next thing before finishing this one. The wanting is genuine and does not switch off at home.

entries.title: Ambivalent
entries.description: Holds both positions fully and will not collapse them for anyone's convenience. Mistaken for indecision by people in a hurry.

entries.title: Arrogant
entries.description: Correct often enough to have stopped checking. The checking is the part everyone actually misses.

entries.title: Brooding
entries.description: Processing something at length and in private. Will surface with a conclusion nobody watched them reach.

entries.title: Bubbly
entries.description: Runs at a temperature the room has to adjust to. The energy is real and costs more than it appears to.

entries.title: Calm
entries.description: The pulse does not move when the situation does. Invaluable in a crisis and unnerving in an argument.

entries.title: Carefree
entries.description: Genuinely not carrying it. Looks like luck from outside and is mostly a decision, repeated daily.

entries.title: Caring
entries.description: Notices what somebody needs before they say it, then provides it without announcing that they noticed.

entries.title: Charming
entries.description: Makes the other person feel interesting, which is a skill rather than a trick. Works on people who know exactly what it is.

entries.title: Cheerful
entries.description: Chooses the better reading of an ambiguous situation. Has been wrong about this and remains undeterred.

entries.title: Cold
entries.description: Feels it and declines to display it. People read the surface and get the temperature wrong every single time.

entries.title: Confident
entries.description: Acts before consensus arrives. Sometimes that is leadership and sometimes it is only being first.

entries.title: Coolheaded
entries.description: Thinks at the same speed under pressure as without it. Not calm exactly; the processing simply does not degrade.

entries.title: Cynical
entries.description: Assumes the interested motive and is right often enough to keep the habit. Quietly disappointed by every exception.

entries.title: Daring
entries.description: Takes the shot with the odds visible and unimproved. Knows the number and goes regardless.

entries.title: Deceptive
entries.description: Tells the truth in an order that produces a false picture. Technically accurate throughout, which is the craft of it.

entries.title: Demanding
entries.description: Sets a bar and will not lower it for comfort. Holds themselves to the same one, which is why anybody stays.

entries.title: Detached
entries.description: Present, participating, and standing slightly outside it. Reports on their own life like a third party.

entries.title: Dreamy
entries.description: Half the attention is somewhere better. The other half is still more than most people bring.

entries.title: Eccentric
entries.description: Solved a set of ordinary problems in ways nobody else considered, then kept the solutions.

entries.title: Euphoric
entries.description: Lit up well past the occasion. Wonderful company, and slightly alarming to anyone tracking the descent.

entries.title: Fearless
entries.description: The fear signal does not arrive. This is a genuine advantage and a well-documented liability.

entries.title: Friendly
entries.description: Opens toward strangers by default. That default has cost them and has not been revised.

entries.title: Gloomy
entries.description: Expects the weather to turn and is usually right. Carries the umbrella everyone else ends up borrowing.

entries.title: Greedy
entries.description: The amount that would be enough keeps moving. They have noticed this and have not stopped.

entries.title: Gregarious
entries.description: Refuels in company and empties out alone, which is the opposite of how most people are wired.

entries.title: Grumpy
entries.description: Objects loudly and helps anyway. The objecting is not a preview of the answer.

entries.title: Hostile
entries.description: Treats the room as opposition until proven otherwise. Proof is accepted; it is rarely offered.

entries.title: Hotheaded
entries.description: Reaches the ceiling in seconds and comes down almost as fast. Everyone else takes longer to recover than they do.

entries.title: Humble
entries.description: Has the credentials and declines to lead with them. Discovering this later is the moment people start trusting them.

entries.title: Impatient
entries.description: Sees the end of the process from the start and resents every step standing between.

entries.title: Innocent
entries.description: Has not yet been given a reason. Not naive; simply working from a fair sample.

entries.title: Jovial
entries.description: Enlarges the room. Laughs first and loudest and means it, which is the part that makes it work.

entries.title: Lazy
entries.description: Finds the shortest path with real skill, then spends the time saved on nothing in particular.

entries.title: Meticulous
entries.description: Checks the thing nobody checks. Slow at the start and never slow at the end.

entries.title: Moody
entries.description: The weather is internal and moves fast. Everyone learns to read it and nobody learns to predict it.

entries.title: Obedient
entries.description: Follows the instruction completely, including the parts the instructor has forgotten giving.

entries.title: Paranoid
entries.description: Models the worst version and prepares for it. Has been right twice, which was enough to settle the matter.

entries.title: Patient
entries.description: Waits without the waiting costing them anything. Reads as serenity and is closer to stamina.

entries.title: Polite
entries.description: Maintains the form regardless of provocation. The form is armor, and everyone can tell when it thickens.

entries.title: Quirky
entries.description: The angle is genuinely theirs rather than assembled. Cannot be performed, though it has been attempted.

entries.title: Realistic
entries.description: Names the constraint out loud while everyone else is still hoping. Unpopular early and quoted later.

entries.title: Rebellious
entries.description: Tests whether the rule is load-bearing. Frequently it is not, and occasionally the discovery is expensive.

entries.title: Relaxed
entries.description: Nothing is urgent until it demonstrably is. The threshold is high and, so far, correctly calibrated.

entries.title: Resilient
entries.description: Takes the hit and is functional the next morning. The recovery is not effortless; it is simply reliable.

entries.title: Romantic
entries.description: Reads the world for meaning rather than mechanics. This produces poetry and disappointment in roughly equal amounts.

entries.title: Rude
entries.description: Skips the softening entirely. The information is accurate and arrives without any packaging at all.

entries.title: Scheming
entries.description: Several moves ahead and enjoying it. The plan usually works and is rarely as necessary as the planning implied.

entries.title: Selfish
entries.description: Weighs their own interest first and does not pretend otherwise. The honesty makes it both worse and easier.

entries.title: Sensitive
entries.description: Registers the shift in a room before anyone names it. Receives far more signal than is comfortable to carry.

entries.title: Shy
entries.description: Wants the connection and cannot get the first sentence out. The wanting is the part people miss.

entries.title: Skeptical
entries.description: Asks for the evidence, accepts it when it arrives, and is genuinely pleased to be convinced.

entries.title: Tactful
entries.description: Says the difficult thing in the form the listener can actually hear. Costs them time and gets it heard.

entries.title: Theatrical
entries.description: Plays every scene to the back row. Life is not larger for them, it is simply scaled correctly.

entries.title: Timid
entries.description: Hesitates at the threshold, then goes through more often than anybody gives them credit for.

entries.title: Unyielding
entries.description: Does not move once the position is taken. A virtue and a structural problem, depending on the week.

entries.title: Visionary
entries.description: Sees the finished thing before the first step exists and struggles to explain the middle.

entries.title: Whimsical
entries.description: Follows the odd idea to find out where it goes. Roughly one in five arrives somewhere worth the trip.

entries.title: Wise
entries.description: Has made the mistake already and would rather you did not. Will let you anyway if that is the only route.

entries.title: Adaptable
entries.description: Reshapes to the situation without treating it as a loss. Whatever they were doing before is negotiable.

entries.title: Adventurous
entries.description: Prefers the unfamiliar version of any option. The known one remains available and is rarely chosen.

entries.title: Aloof
entries.description: Keeps a distance that is deliberate rather than defensive. Comes closer on their own schedule and nobody else's.

entries.title: Analytical
entries.description: Breaks the thing into parts before responding to it. Slower to react and considerably harder to fool.

entries.title: Anxious
entries.description: Runs every branch of what might happen. Exhausting to be, and occasionally the reason nothing went wrong.

entries.title: Awkward
entries.description: Misses the timing by a fraction, consistently. Everything else about them is worth the fraction.

entries.title: Bold
entries.description: States the position first and loudest, before knowing how the room intends to take it.

entries.title: Buoyant
entries.description: Returns to the surface regardless of what pushed them under. The mechanism is not understood, including by them.

entries.title: Calculating
entries.description: Runs the numbers on situations most people feel their way through. The numbers are usually right.

entries.title: Cautious
entries.description: Checks the footing before committing weight. Slower to arrive and considerably more likely to arrive.

entries.title: Compassionate
entries.description: Sits with somebody's difficulty without needing to solve it, which is rarer and harder than solving it.

entries.title: Considerate
entries.description: Accounts for the other person's constraints before proposing anything. The accounting happens silently.

entries.title: Consistent
entries.description: The same on a bad day. Unremarkable until you need it, at which point it is the only thing that matters.

entries.title: Creative
entries.description: Connects two things nobody had put together. Produces a great deal of nonsense on the way and does not mind.

entries.title: Earnest
entries.description: Means it, plainly, with no irony held in reserve. Disarms people who arrived prepared for a different conversation.

entries.title: Empathetic
entries.description: Feels the other person's state rather than inferring it. Accurate, and not switchable.

entries.title: Excessive
entries.description: Does more than the situation requires, every time. Occasionally that is exactly right and nobody can predict which times.

entries.title: Excitable
entries.description: Goes from nothing to everything with no visible ramp. The enthusiasm is contagious and briefly overwhelming.

entries.title: Flexible
entries.description: Holds the goal firmly and the method loosely. Confused for indecision by anyone watching only the method.

entries.title: Focused
entries.description: Everything outside the task stops existing. Extraordinary output, and somebody else has to remind them to eat.

entries.title: Gentle
entries.description: Handles people and objects as though they might be fragile, which most of them turn out to be.

entries.title: Hardworking
entries.description: Keeps going after the interesting part ends. That is the entire distinction, and it is a large one.

entries.title: Idealistic
entries.description: Holds a standard the world has not met yet. Disappointed constantly and has not lowered it once.

entries.title: Impulsive
entries.description: Acts on the first instinct and sorts the consequences afterward. The instinct is right more often than the method deserves.

entries.title: Indifferent
entries.description: Genuinely has no preference, which people persistently read as a hidden one.

entries.title: Industrious
entries.description: Always mid-project. Rest gets scheduled and then treated as another task to complete properly.

entries.title: Insensitive
entries.description: Misses the signal entirely rather than ignoring it. The distinction matters to them and rarely to anybody else.

entries.title: Intense
entries.description: Full weight on everything, small things included. Exhausting in bulk and unmatched in a crisis.

entries.title: Irreverent
entries.description: Declines to treat anything as sitting above a joke. Aimed upward far more often than down, which is the saving detail.

entries.title: Measured
entries.description: Speaks after thinking rather than during. The pause reads as hesitation and is not.

entries.title: Mercurial
entries.description: Changes without warning and without contradiction. Both versions were entirely sincere at the time.

entries.title: Methodical
entries.description: Follows the order even when a shortcut is visible. Finishes later and has to redo nothing.

entries.title: Mysterious
entries.description: Withholds without lying. People fill the gap themselves and then blame them for whatever they put in it.

entries.title: Nostalgic
entries.description: Measures now against one specific then. The then has been quietly edited and they know it.

entries.title: Nurturing
entries.description: Builds the conditions other people grow in, then steps back before the credit arrives.

entries.title: Playful
entries.description: Turns the task into a game and finishes faster that way. Nobody believes this until they watch it happen.

entries.title: Poetic
entries.description: Reaches for the image rather than the explanation. Sometimes clearer, always slower.

entries.title: Practical
entries.description: Asks what will actually work here, with these materials, today.

entries.title: Pragmatic
entries.description: Trades the ideal outcome for the achievable one without mourning it. Gets more done and sleeps fine.

entries.title: Predictable
entries.description: You know what they will do. This has been used against them and is still why people rely on them.

entries.title: Principled
entries.description: Has lines and will pay for them. The paying happens quietly and does not get mentioned afterward.

entries.title: Prosaic
entries.description: Says the plain version. No ornament, no lift, and nothing lost on the way across.

entries.title: Reserved
entries.description: Holds most of it back by default. Whatever does come out was selected rather than leaked.

entries.title: Resourceful
entries.description: Solves it with what is already in the room. The solution is rarely elegant and is always in time.

entries.title: Reverent
entries.description: Treats certain things as genuinely serious without performing the seriousness.

entries.title: Serious
entries.description: Weighs a matter properly before responding to it. Funny in private, which surprises people.

entries.title: Sincere
entries.description: The stated reason is the actual reason. Takes people a while to stop hunting for the other one.

entries.title: Stoic
entries.description: Carries it without commentary. Not unaffected, simply unwilling to make it the room's problem.

entries.title: Stubborn
entries.description: Will not be moved by pressure and can occasionally be moved by argument. That distinction is everything.

entries.title: Tactical
entries.description: Thinks in positions and sequences. Plays the current move for the sake of the one after it.

entries.title: Terse
entries.description: Uses the fewest words that carry it. Nothing is missing; it is simply not padded.

entries.title: Unpredictable
entries.description: A pattern exists and nobody has found it. Including, on some days, them.

entries.title: Verbose
entries.description: Takes the long way round and picks up things worth having. The point arrives eventually and arrives well supplied.

entries.title: Warm
entries.description: Makes people feel welcome with no effort and no agenda. The absence of agenda is what they actually notice.

entries.title: Witty
entries.description: Finds the angle fast and says it before the moment closes. Occasionally at somebody's expense and usually not.
